rows.text: refiles its 17 September intimation to say the rating action was misstated: Infomerics **reaffirmed IVR BBB and revised the outlook to Positive**, rather than upgrading the long-term rating as first reported.
Infomerics **revises its long-term outlook to IVR BBB/Positive from IVR BBB/Stable** and reaffirms IVR A3+ on the short term.
Century Extrusions Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates

fixes the terms of its **Rs 45 crore rights issue: 3,00,00,000 partly paid shares at Rs 15, three for every eight held, record date 15 September, open 23 September to 14 October**, and files the Letter of Offer.
